scope: Per-site structural homology prediction; not cofactor occupancy or function proof

validation_guard.evidence_scope: Previously inspected source-withheld species; development validation, not a sealed final blind test

rules: Ligand chemistry is checked at mapped coordinates including His and Asp; never inferred from total Cys count.
New Cys in a three-ligand 3Fe4S site window is ambiguous; non-ligand Cys gain alone does not invalidate a fully mapped four-ligand site.
Incomplete source ligand sets cannot yield template_supported type transfer.
Conflicting competitive templates sharing mapped ligand positions yield ambiguous.
No output is evidence of actual occupancy; no-site output does not prove absence of FeS.
Evidence windows are sequence coverage guards, not experimentally defined complete structural domains.

Huc proximal N61 and distal Q246 are sequence-comparable alternative coordination positions; new C/H/D there prevents forced 3Fe4S assignment. Other unknown alternatives remain a calibration limitation.

A separate reviewed-site-window search may resolve an unknown full-reference hypothesis only for identical query ligand positions/residues and the same cluster type, with complete reviewed alternative coordination and all unchanged local gates; no new site added. Multiple supported local types remain ambiguous; uncertainty, alternative-ligand and incomplete-source guards are never bypassed.

HydB template7P92 Tyr601 aligns to consumed StnB8OH5 His559, whose ND1 is2.049A from Fe. New C/H/D at this reviewed alternative position causes ambiguity even if all four template Cys remain. This is a potential ligand-gain warning, not a full alternate coordination set, hydrogenase identity or activity proof.
